verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is fundamentally API-first: the self-hosted product ships only a minimal default search-preview 'web interface' for testing (docs-2), and virtually every capability (indexing, settings, ranking rules, facets, hybrid search, tenant tokens) is documented purely as API/config operations, with the official MCP server translating natural-language prompts directly into the same API calls (docs-13, docs-17, probe-4, rt-3) — strongly suggesting API parity. However, there is no explicit documentation enumerating Meilisearch Cloud dashboard features (clusterization, analytics dashboards) and confirming each is also exposed via API, so full UI/API parity for Cloud-specific features is unverified. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation for Meilisearch Cloud dashboard features (analytics UI, cluster management) versus API, and independent confirmation that no UI-only actions exist.
